results.subject: Main DG scheduled service
results.body: Please arrange the covered quarterly service for Main DG at our Whitefield warehouse. The asset label reads AST-101. Tuesday morning is preferred.

attachments.name: service-label.jpg
attachments.summary: Equipment label photographed on site: Northstar asset AST-101, 250 kVA diesel generator, serial NS-DG-4481.

results.subject: Hoskote freezer temperature rising
results.body: The freezer plant at our Hoskote cold store is not pulling down below -12°C. I am off site and do not have the asset number. Product is still within tolerance but we need someone to look at this today.

results.subject: Fuel smell near backup generator
results.body: Security reports a strong diesel smell and unusual vibration near the backup generator at our Indiranagar centre. They have kept people away from the room. Please advise urgently.

attachments.name: security-photo.jpg
attachments.summary: Security photo taken from the doorway. The generator room is cordoned off; a dark wet patch is visible below the fuel-line side of the unit.

results.subject: Compressor not listed in portal
results.body: Please dispatch someone for compressor CMP-77 on line 2. I cannot find it in our covered asset list, but it was installed during last month's expansion.

attachments.name: commissioning-note.pdf
attachments.summary: Helix commissioning note dated 28 August 2026 for compressor CMP-77 on line 2. It records installation and acceptance, but contains no Northstar contract or covered-asset reference.

results.subject: Following up: Main DG service
results.body: Kavya raised the Main DG service request from the portal a few minutes ago. This email is for the same AST-101 visit. Please don't create a second job.

results.subject: Freezer plant 2 stopped
results.body: AST-302 at SITE-021 has stopped cooling. There is no smoke, water or unusual smell. The room is at -9°C and rising.

attachments.name: controller-reading.jpg
attachments.summary: Controller display shows -9.1°C and alarm E42 (low suction pressure). Photo timestamp: 09:29 IST.

results.subject: Electrical-certified technician needed
results.body: AST-205 at the Whitefield clinic needs an electrical-certified generator technician today. No one is in danger and the generator remains offline.

results.subject: Coverage confirmation for AST-101
results.body: Before the visit, please confirm coverage for AST-101 using the amendment signed in August. The older base contract does not include the revised generator schedule.

attachments.name: contract-amendment-reference.txt
attachments.summary: Reference supplied by customer: CON-012 amendment A2, signed 12 August 2026. Customer asks Northstar to use the amended preventive-maintenance schedule.

results.subject: CRAC 3 alarm returned
results.body: The high-temperature warning on Server room CRAC 3 has returned after last week's visit. Asset AST-702. Current room temperature is stable at 22°C.

attachments.name: alarm-log.csv
attachments.summary: Three high-temperature warnings from CRAC 3 at 01:14, 01:22 and 01:37. Each cleared within four minutes. Sensor readings peaked at 25.8°C.

results.subject: Packing hall AC noisy
results.body: The packing hall AC has developed a rattling noise. Cooling is normal. This is AST-501 at the Yeshwanthpur hub.

results.subject: Line 4 pressure falling again
results.body: Line 4 compressor AST-601 is losing pressure during the second shift, similar to REQ-8120. Production has not stopped yet. Can you check the previous work and advise the next step?

results.subject: Banquet chiller inspection
results.body: Please schedule an inspection for the banquet chiller AST-801 before this weekend's event. The account portal says service is on hold, but our finance team says the renewal payment was made yesterday.

attachments.name: payment-reference.pdf
attachments.summary: Bank transfer advice for ₹1,84,000 dated 19 September 2026. The document references Riverbend Hotels but does not confirm that Northstar has received or allocated the payment.

results.subject: Backup DG controller fault
results.body: Dialysis backup DG AST-901 shows controller fault 118. There is no smoke or smell. Please arrange someone on site before the evening shift.

results.subject: AHU 2 airflow weak
results.body: Sortation hall AHU 2, AST-1001, has weak airflow again. Cooling remains within range. Please review the June visit before assigning this.

results.subject: Water beside instrument UPS
results.body: There is water on the floor beside instrument UPS AST-1102. The area is being kept clear and nobody has touched the equipment.

attachments.name: corridor-photo.jpg
attachments.summary: Photo from outside the marked area shows water extending toward the UPS cabinet.

results.subject: Press compressor pressure oscillation
results.body: AST-1201 pressure is oscillating again during long runs. Production is continuing. Please compare with the July work order.

results.subject: Auditorium chiller service
results.body: Please plan the quarterly service for auditorium chiller AST-1302 next week under amendment CON-129-A1.

results.subject: DG B failed remote start
results.body: Fulfilment DG B AST-1002 failed a remote start test. No smoke, fuel smell or water is present. The site is currently on utility power.

attachments.name: controller-log.txt
attachments.summary: Controller log shows start attempt rejected after low starter-voltage reading.
